# 謝文淵 Joseph Hsieh

> I'm Joseph Hsieh. I bring more than 25 years of experience running and investing in financial services businesses. My work centers on leading corporate transformation and building second growth curves, and I believe capital should create both financial returns and social value.

我是謝文淵。逾 25 年金融產業經營與投資經驗，工作核心是主導企業轉型，以及第二成長曲線的發掘與經營；長期信念是資本應同時創造財務報酬與社會價值。
